column4: the repository calls itself PYRIS under BOTH names

column1: # CONCLUSION: ONE repository. `ls1intum/Iris` is a GitHub name alias that resolves to
# `ls1intum/Pyris`; it is not a separately buildable component. Iris is the USER-FACING
# name of the tutor Pyris powers inside Artemis, documented at a web page
# README verbatim: "Pyris is an intermediary system that connects the Artemis platform with
# various Large Language Models (LLMs)... Currently, Pyris powers Iris, a virtual AI tutor".
